reviews.text: Having reached out at the beginning of the year for socialisation of our working spaniel, Hugo started on the companion service where the Friday group walking was exactly what he needed. Since then we have added a Thursday walk as well as Hugo enjoys his time so much across both days. Thanks to Ross, Tina and Claire I am confident of a well walked and mentally tired working dog on his return. Would recommend to anyone needing assistance with dog care.

Exceptional care for our puppy who now goes out for around 4 hours a day and comes home lovely and shattered. She’s now well socialized and a happy girl! Thankyou Claire and Tina for all of your love and care xx

We recently moved to the area and reached out to MBF as we reluctantly had to leave our original dog walker we'd been with for years - so we were quite picky with what we wanted. Rest assured, Ross is super knowledgeable (especially about Spaniels!), safety always comes first (they have to walk with a tracker before he knows whether their recall is good enough) & just a genuinely nice guy. My energetic Cocker Spaniel is always super chilled & tired after her long walks chasing sticks through the woods. She especially loves her swims on the Friday reservoir walks too!
